name: @coding-adventures/forme-doc-toc-extractor
description: Walk a DocumentNode AST and produce a nested table-of-contents tree from its headings.  Output is a plain JSON-able tree of { text, id, level, children } entries that a sidebar widget, in-page TOC, or PDF outline can render directly.  Pure transform; capabilities []; depends on @coding-adventures/forme-doc-heading-anchors (which itself depends only on document-ast).  DOC00 v0 content-pipeline package.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
